applies_to: the unchanged CRTR score producer across all declared risk policies and one-axis neighbors

score_boundary.hook_input: built-in dict[str,float] with sorted symbol insertion order and finite scores
score_boundary.timing: after every declared score transform and before score-span checks, asset selection, sleeve construction, or weighting
score_boundary.identity_requirement: Amendment 0005 hook must return the same keys and finite float values; strategy construction consumes the returned mapping
score_boundary.score_direction: higher score predicts higher simple executable-open-to-open return

label.name: forward_3d_simple_executable_open_to_open_return
label.entry: organizer-authoritative executable transaction open used for a target produced at decision_time; the price is never exposed to the strategy
label.exit: first organizer-authoritative executable transaction open at or after entry_time + 3 calendar days
label.price_requirements: both opens must be finite and strictly positive
label.membership_requirements: symbol must be in the score map and executable at both endpoints
label.missing_rule: omit the symbol-boundary observation; never substitute, carry, fill, or shorten the horizon
label.overlap_rule: labels are diagnostic only; compute each scheduled score boundary independently and do not use labels as strategy inputs

information_coefficient.paired_universe: intersection of score-map symbols and valid labels under the label rule
information_coefficient.statistic: Spearman rank correlation, implemented as Pearson correlation of average ranks
information_coefficient.ties: exact average ranks for both score and label; symbol text is only a deterministic serialization tie-breaker
information_coefficient.undefined_rule: omit boundary IC when fewer than 12 pairs or either ranked vector has zero variance
information_coefficient.aggregation: report the count, arithmetic mean, median, positive fraction, and complete ordered boundary-IC series; no value is a qualification gate unless Amendment 0005 says so

canonical_score_payload.invalid_record_rule: Any malformed nonempty PreconstructionScore map returns empty bytes; it must never be coerced or serialized as a valid-looking empty score artifact.
canonical_score_payload.byte_invariance: same causal input must be identical under future append/corruption/truncation, bar-map insertion order, and fresh construction

registration_rule: Do not register or execute any Team-05 candidate until Amendment 0005 and score_adapter_protocol_v5 are frozen and this contract and its manifest are organizer hash-bound.
